usedFor: Sangam CRM captures leads, and ClearBounce checks their addresses when “New Lead Created” runs “Verify Email Address”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Sangam CRM, then “Verify Email Address” in ClearBounce
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead has its email checked for validity before anyone sends it a message.

watchOut: “New Lead Created” is polling, so verification runs after a scheduled check and not at capture.
